name: 35128 · Pell City, AL
findings: ZIP 35128 (Pell City) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35128 (Pell City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
